voice_notes.transcript: okay first real one. derek oh say from pinnacle rehab, mississauga, six clinics, six. every clinic runs off its own google calendar and then somebody at head office copies it all into a master spreadsheet every friday. he's the ops guy not the owner. wants the security one pager for their IT person before anything else. good guy. big.

sophie trembly, gatineau, massage, just her and two others I think. she's on pract shift and they started charging her per text reminder this summer and she's pretty mad about it. didn't ask for anything really. french speaker, nadia should maybe write to her.

jen from bayview, the three clinics in moncton, she's on book stead and book stead double booked her saturday RMTs twice in august, she was really fired up about that. she wants a demo with her clinic managers. and her business partner ravi was with her, he's the numbers guy, he wants pricing per practitioner, they've got fourteen practitioners across the three. both of them. hot.

gord potty, pottie maybe, sports physio up in sydney nova scotia. one clinic, paper book. his one front desk person is drowning in phone bookings, she does everything. he wants a trial for her, not a demo, he said just let her play with it. I said we'd set that up.

amira, still waters massage in halifax. three RMTs on one shared google calendar and they keep overwriting each other's bookings. she wants pricing. and she was really clear, do not put her on any mailing list, she hates newsletters, just send her the pricing. so, pricing only. she didn't give me a card, I scanned her.

grace, whitford, the lady with all the dog photos on her phone. two massage clinics in ottawa. pract shift keeps logging her RMTs out in the middle of the day. she's not shopping yet but she's annoyed. oh and her dad's in hospital in kingston so she's a bit all over the place, don't, you know, don't bring that up.

nadia just told me about one she had in french, a physio from shediac, ellen or helen arsenault, on clean evo, her contract renews at the end of the year and nadia told her we'd call her after thanksgiving. nadia has her card. putting it here so we don't lose it.

duncan ferris, charlottetown, physio, one clinic, on clinivo. what he really wants is for clients to grab the last minute cancellation slots online instead of his front desk phoning down a list. nice chat. didn't ask for anything.
liam, the RMT from fredericton, the tall guy. paper book, solo. nice guy, not ready, he said maybe next year. nothing to send really.
peggy from riverside massage, fredericton too. office manager. she wants something she can show the owner, so send her the brochure or the one pager. she's not the decision maker.

okay day two. steve from grandview, five sites, kitchener waterloo. on pract shift. his renewal is at the end of the year and he wants to compare before then, so demo asap. he's the guy with the bow tie. he said he'll bring his ops lead.

shauna from st john's, seawall massage. one clinic now, second location opening in mount pearl in october. paper book at the moment. she said call me once the new place is open, not before, she's slammed.
dan pothier, atlantic motion, three clinics, halifax and bedford, on clinivo and he hates the reporting, he can't get a number out of it. wants a demo. good one.

patrick from bathurst, doucet physio, he went to dal with sam, small world. he ditched book stead in april and he's running the whole clinic off a spreadsheet now. wants a demo but not till he's back from vacation, he's back on the fifth.

correction on jen from bayview from yesterday, she came back by, she said monday the twenty eighth works for the demo, mornings, and to copy her ops manager. so demo with managers, week of the twenty eighth.
yvonne, saint john, one clinic, paper. but she literally said book me a demo. she's sick of answering the phone all day. one clinic but she means it.
scanner's still dead. farah from westdale massage in hamilton, google calendar, she wants to try it with her two RMTs first before she shows anyone. so set her up with a trial. got her card.
tyler brennan, brennan and ward, two clinics, oakville, on book stead. wants pricing but in writing, his business partner won't look at anything that isn't in writing. got his card, scanner's down.
mei lin from markham, acupuncture and massage, one clinic, on clinivo. wants a demo. asked whether reminders can go out in mandarin, a lot of her clients would want that. I said I'd check.
ben from northline, four clinics in ottawa, every front desk still uses a paper book, can you believe it. he's the manager not the owner. send him something he can take to the owner.
lucie from dieppe, massage, paper, we mostly talked about her kids' hockey. nothing there really. nadia has her card.
okay wrap up. talked to a lot of people. scanner died for about an hour after lunch today so the cards from then are in my bag. nadia has some cards too. I'll do a list on the plane.
